scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A directional zero–one law under strict ellipticity” (preprints/A-directional-zero-one-law-under-strict-ellipticity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 220 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 245e917113b3545b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let d ≥ 3, let P be an independent and identically distributed law of nearest- neighbor transition rows on Zd satisfying (1), and let ℓ ∈ Rd \ {0}. Then P0(Aℓ) ∈ {0, 1}.
